candidates.name: Niemann-Pick disease
support_spans: dense granulomatous infiltrate in the upper dermis consisting of histiocytes, lymphocytes, foam cells, multinucleated giant cells, eosinophils, and hemorrhage

reddish-brown papules, nodules, and plaques on his periocular areas, perioral areas, neck, shoulder, axillary folds, cubital fossa, wrists, palms, umbilical region, lateral abdomen, inguinal area, anogenital area, popliteal fossa, and ankles
candidates.why: The combination of skin lesions and systemic symptoms such as polydipsia, polyuria, central diabetes insipidus, growth retardation, and hypothyroidism, along with the specific findings of foam cells in the skin biopsy, points towards a lysosomal storage disorder like Niemann-Pick disease.
